subject.title: fix: repair full-stack QA, gateway, and channel regressions

question: Should maintainers retain this large integrated repair PR as one landing unit after exact-head proof and failing-gate remediation, or split it into smaller independently reviewable owner-boundary fixes?
rationale: The branch crosses channel activation, Gateway security/compatibility, providers, QA, and the web UI; its protected label, dependency addition, and current failed gates make the acceptable integration scope a maintainer judgment.

options.title: Repair and validate the integrated head
options.body: Resolve each failed required gate, review the dependency report, and add redacted real-behavior evidence for the exact rebased head before normal maintainer merge review.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Separate independently safe channel, Gateway/security, and UI/dependency repairs if failed gates or review reveal that the combined change is too difficult to validate as one unit.

recommendation.title: Repair and validate the integrated head
recommendation.body: Resolve each failed required gate, review the dependency report, and add redacted real-behavior evidence for the exact rebased head before normal maintainer merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head and stated repair campaign are attributed to this contributor, making them the best available routing contact while historical ownership remains unverified.
